Messages.Author: Katana
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Is it possible to continue an action untapped with the Monster + superior Shadow Boxing combo? And if yes, is it also possible to take another action, regardless of being blocked or not, since the minion would be untapped?

Scenario: minion A's action is blocked by opposing minion B. Minion A torporizes minion B in combat, then untaps with Monster and plays Shadow Boxing at superior afterwards.

Thanks in advance,
Katana

Cards:

Monster. Master: archetype.
Put this card on a ready minion you control. Once each turn when combat involving this vampire ends and the opposing minion is not ready, this vampire may burn a blood to untap. A vampire may only have one archetype.

Shadow Boxing. (at superior).
Only usable after a combat resulting from a block. Not usable if the blocking minion is ready. This vampire burns 1 blood to continue the action as if unblocked.
